title: Lower good truncation of a flat K-flat complex
statement: Let (C,J) be a site essentially small in a coefficient universe w, with the stated sheafification and sheaf-composition structures. Let R be a sheaf of commutative rings in universe w, K an unbounded cochain complex of sheaves of R-modules, and a an integer. Suppose K is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex], every term K^i is flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], and the opcycles coker(d^(a-1)) at a are flat. Then the complex with zero terms below a, opcycles at a and original terms above a, with induced differentials (Mathlib K.truncGE a) is K-flat. The site object and morphism universes are independent of w.

proof.text: In an abelian symmetric monoidal category with functorial flat resolutions and right-exact tensor, a short exact sequence with flat quotient remains short exact after tensoring with any object; if its middle term is flat, its kernel is flat. Prove this by resolving the tensor argument by a flat object and chasing the resulting three rows after epic refinements. The site-module flat resolutions and tensor colimits supply these hypotheses.

Let P be the lower good truncation of K and L the kernel of its degreewise epic quotient K to P. The terms of P are zero below a, the given flat opcycles at a, and K^i above a; they are all flat. Apply the preceding tensor exactness statement degreewise: L has flat terms. Above a the quotient is an isomorphism, so L vanishes there. Hence L is K-flat by the bounded-above flat criterion.

For an acyclic complex A, tensor the short exact sequence L to K to P with A in each bidegree. Exact coproducts of sheaves of abelian groups, reflected by the forgetful functor on module sheaves, make the direct-sum total tensor sequence short exact. Its first two complexes are acyclic by K-flatness of L and K. The long exact homology sequence makes the third acyclic. Symmetry gives the tensor order in the independent-coefficient K-flat predicate.
